nodes.statement: Fix the exact curve class: E/Q semistable, odd conductor, good ordinary at 2, E[2] irreducible, and complex analytic rank one.
Bind the complete Hasse-Weil L-function, Neron differential, real period, regulator, Tamagawa factors, torsion denominator, and ord_2 convention to WP00.
Import analytic-rank-one consequences: rank E(Q)=1 and Sha(E/Q) finite.
Establish rationality and exact normalization of L'(E,1)/(Omega_E Reg_E).
Define the 2-primary Selmer structure and compare local conditions at 2 and all bad primes without ordinary/strict/relaxed drift.
Prove a 2-adic main-conjecture, Euler-system, or finite-level substitute strong enough to control the relevant Selmer length.
Prove the required 2-adic explicit-reciprocity or Gross-Zagier comparison with every exceptional and integrality factor explicit.
Compute and verify all local correction terms, including Tamagawa and period/isogeny conversion factors.
Identify the resulting 2-adic length with ord_2 of Sha, Tamagawa, regulator, period, and torsion terms.
Conclude the exact ord_2 valuation identity and nothing stronger.

adversarial_gates.BSD-FP-006: The conclusion is one prime part only and may not be promoted to the full formula.
adversarial_gates.BSD-FP-008: The p=2 ordinary local theory must be stated independently of odd-prime ordinary results.
adversarial_gates.BSD-FP-009: Primitive and imprimitive Euler factors require explicit conversion.
adversarial_gates.BSD-FP-010: The complete complex L-function is mandatory.
adversarial_gates.BSD-FP-011: Period, differential, isogeny, and Manin factors are fixed.
adversarial_gates.BSD-FP-016: No p-adic or derived-height nondegeneracy may be assumed silently.
adversarial_gates.BSD-FP-017: Every Selmer local condition and comparison sequence is named.
adversarial_gates.BSD-FP-018: No BSD identity may be used to generate its own arithmetic inputs.
